title.zh: 卷八十六 列傳第十六: 耶律合住 劉景 劉六符 耶律褭履 牛溫舒 杜防 蕭和尚 耶律合里只 耶律頗的
title.en: Volume 86 Biographies 16: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Ye Luniaolu, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, Xiao Heshang, Yelu Helizhi, Yelu Pode
title.raw: 卷八十六 列傳第十六: 耶律合住 劉景 劉六符 耶律褭履 牛溫舒 杜防 蕭和尚 耶律合里只 耶律頗的 Volume 86 Biographies 16: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Ye Luniaolu, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, Xiao Heshang, Yelu Helizhi, Yelu Pode

sentences.zh: 耶律合住劉景劉六符耶律甗履牛溫舒杜防蕭和尚

translations.literal: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Yelu Niaolu, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, Xiao Heshang.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Hezhu, Liu Jing, Liu Liufu, Yelu Niaolu, Niu Wenshu, Du Fang, and Xiao Heshang.

translations.literal: Open angle bracket (section marker)

sentences.zh: （特末）〉

translations.literal: (Temo has a separate biography)
translations.idiomatic: (See the biography of Temo below)

sentences.zh: 耶律合裏只耶律頗的

translations.literal: Yelu Helizhi, Yelu Pode.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Helizhi and Yelu Pode.

sentences.zh: 耶律合住，字粘袞，太祖弟叠剌之孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Hezhu, style name Niangun, was a grandson of Diela, younger brother of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Hezhu, whose style name was Niangun, was a grandson of Diela, a younger brother of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 幼不好弄，臨事明敏，善談論。

translations.literal: In youth he disliked idle play; in affairs he was sharp and perceptive, and skilled in discussion.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he shunned frivolous pastimes; when matters arose he was quick and clear-minded, and he excelled in debate.

sentences.zh: 初以近族入侍，每從征伐有功。

translations.literal: He first entered court service as a close clansman and repeatedly distinguished himself on campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered the palace as a near kinsman of the throne and won merit on campaign after campaign.

sentences.zh: 保寧初，加右龍虎衛上將軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoning he was promoted to Senior General of the Right Guard of the Dragon-Tiger Corps.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Baoning era he was made Senior General of the Right Guard of the Dragon-Tiger Corps.

sentences.zh: 以宋師屢梗南邊，拜涿州刺史，西南兵馬都監、招安、巡檢等使，賜推忠奉國功臣。

translations.literal: Because Song forces repeatedly obstructed the southern frontier, he was appointed Prefect of Zhuo, Commissioner of Southwestern Military Affairs, Pacification Commissioner, Inspection Commissioner, and the like, and was granted the title Meritorious Subject Who Pushes Loyalty and Serves the State.
translations.idiomatic: As Song armies repeatedly blocked the southern border, he was appointed Prefect of Zhuo, given charge of southwestern forces as Pacification and Inspection Commissioner, and granted the title Meritorious Subject Who Pushes Loyalty and Serves the State.

sentences.zh: 合住久任邊防，雖有克獲功，然務鎮靜，不妄生事以邀近功。

translations.literal: Hezhu long held frontier posts; though he won victories from time to time, he strove for calm and would not rashly stir up trouble to win quick credit.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhu served long on the frontier; though he sometimes took the field with success, he prized steadiness and would not provoke incidents merely to win immediate credit.

sentences.zh: 鄰壤敬畏，屬部乂安。

translations.literal: Neighboring lands held him in awe, and subordinate tribes lived in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Neighboring territories respected him, and the tribes under his charge lived in order.

sentences.zh: 宋數遣人結歡，冀達和意，合住表聞其事，帝許議和。

translations.literal: The Song repeatedly sent envoys to court friendship, hoping to convey their wish for peace; Hezhu memorialized the emperor, who approved negotiation.
translations.idiomatic: The Song repeatedly sent envoys to court favor, hoping to make their wish for peace understood; Hezhu reported this to the throne, and the emperor approved talks.

sentences.zh: 安邊懷敵，多有力焉。

translations.literal: In securing the borders and winning over foes abroad, he contributed greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In pacifying the frontier and winning over enemies abroad, he played a leading part.

sentences.zh: 拜左金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed Senior General of the Left Golden-Impetus Guard Corps.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Senior General of the Left Golden-Impetus Guard Corps.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，遙攝鎮國軍節度使，卒。

translations.literal: When his term expired, he was given nominal charge as Military Commissioner of Zhenguo Army and died.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he was given nominal appointment as Military Commissioner of the Zhenguo Army, and soon after he died.

sentences.zh: 合住智而有文，曉暢戎政。

translations.literal: Hezhu was intelligent and literate, and thoroughly understood military administration.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhu was both clever and literate, and thoroughly versed in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 鎮范陽時，嘗領數騎徑詣雄州北門，與郡將立馬陳兩國利害，及周師侵邊本末。

translations.literal: While stationed at Fanyang, he once led several horsemen straight to the north gate of Xiong Prefecture and, standing beside the prefect's horse, laid out the benefits and harms for both states and the full course of the Zhou army's invasion of the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: While governing Fanyang, he once took a few horsemen straight to the north gate of Xiong Prefecture and, halting beside the prefect, set forth the interests of both states and the whole story of the Zhou armies' incursions.

sentences.zh: 辭氣慷慨，左右壯之。

translations.literal: His words were impassioned, and those about him took heart.
translations.idiomatic: His tone was ardent, and those around him were stirred.

sentences.zh: 自是，邊境數年無事。

translations.literal: From then on the border was largely free of trouble for several years.
translations.idiomatic: After that the frontier was largely untroubled for several years.

sentences.zh: 識者以謂合住一言，賢於數十萬兵。

translations.literal: Discerning observers said that one statement by Hezhu was worth more than hundreds of thousands of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Men of judgment said that a single speech by Hezhu was worth more than hundreds of thousands of troops.

sentences.zh: 劉景，字可大，河間人。

translations.literal: Liu Jing, style name Ke Da, was a native of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jing, whose style name was Ke Da, came from Hejian.

sentences.zh: 四世祖怦，即朱滔之甥，唐右僕射、盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: His fourth-generation ancestor Bang was the nephew of Zhu Tao, Tang Right Vice Director and Military Commissioner of Lulong.
translations.idiomatic: His fourth-generation ancestor Bang was Zhu Tao's nephew and served the Tang as Right Vice Director and Military Commissioner of Lulong.

sentences.zh: 父守敬，南京副留守。

translations.literal: His father Shoujing served as Deputy Military Governor of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shoujing was Deputy Military Governor of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 景資端厚，好學能文。

translations.literal: Jing was composed and steady, fond of learning and skilled at writing.
translations.idiomatic: Jing was grave and steady, devoted to learning and accomplished in letters.

sentences.zh: 燕王趙延壽辟為幽都府文學。

translations.literal: Prince of Yan Zhao Yanshou recruited him as a literary officer of the Youdu prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yan, Zhao Yanshou, recruited him as a literary officer of the Youdu prefectural staff.

sentences.zh: 應歷初，遷右拾遺、知制誥，為翰林學士。

translations.literal: Early in Yingli he was transferred to Right Reminder of the Secretariat and Director of Edicts, and became a Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yingli era he was made Right Reminder of the Secretariat and Director of Edicts, and entered the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 九年，周人侵燕，留守蕭思溫上急變，帝欲俟秋出師，景諫曰：「河北三關已陷於敵，今復侵燕，安可坐視！

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when Zhou forces invaded Yan, military governor Xiao Siwen submitted an urgent report; the emperor wished to wait until autumn to take the field. Jing remonstrated: "The three passes of Hebei have fallen to the enemy; now they invade Yan again—how can we sit by and watch!
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when Zhou armies invaded Yan, the military governor Xiao Siwen sent an urgent report; the emperor wished to wait until autumn before marching. Jing remonstrated: "The three passes of Hebei have already fallen to the enemy, and now they invade Yan again—how can we sit idle!

sentences.zh: 」上不聽。

translations.literal: " The emperor did not heed him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 會父憂去。

translations.literal: He then left office on mourning for his father.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon left office to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 未幾，起復舊職。

translations.literal: Before long he was recalled to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was recalled from mourning to his former post.

sentences.zh: 一日，召草赦，既成，留數月不出。

translations.literal: One day he was summoned to draft an amnesty; when it was finished it was held for months without being issued.
translations.idiomatic: One day he was summoned to draft an amnesty edict; when it was finished it was kept for months without being promulgated.

sentences.zh: 景奏曰：「唐制，赦書日行五百里，今稽期弗發，非也。

translations.literal: Jing submitted: "Under Tang regulations an amnesty edict travels five hundred li a day; to delay it beyond the proper date is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Jing submitted: "Under Tang regulations an amnesty travels five hundred li a day; to hold it past its proper date is wrong.

sentences.zh: 」上亦不報。

translations.literal: " The emperor again gave no reply.
translations.idiomatic: " Again the emperor made no response.

sentences.zh: 景宗即位，以景忠實，擢禮部侍郎，遷尚書、宣政殿學士。

translations.literal: When Emperor Jingzong took the throne, considering Jing loyal and solid, he promoted him to Vice Minister of Rites, then to Director and Academician of the Xuanzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Jingzong succeeded, finding Jing loyal and solid, he promoted him to Vice Minister of Rites and then to Director and Academician of the Xuanzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 上方欲倚用，乃書其笏曰：「劉景可為宰相。

translations.literal: The emperor, wishing to rely on him, wrote on his tablet: "Liu Jing can serve as Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, intending to rely on him heavily, wrote on his tablet: "Liu Jing can serve as chancellor.

sentences.zh: 」頃之，為南京副留守。

translations.literal: " Shortly afterward he became Deputy Military Governor of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long he was made Deputy Military Governor of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 時留守韓匡嗣因扈從北上，景與其子德讓共理京事。

translations.literal: At the time Military Governor Han Kuangsi had gone north with the entourage; Jing and his son De rang jointly handled capital affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the military governor Han Kuangsi had gone north with the imperial train; Jing and his son De rang jointly administered affairs of the capital.

sentences.zh: 俄召為戶部使，歷武定、開遠二軍節度使。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned as Commissioner of the Household Bureau, then served as Military Commissioner of Wuding and Kaiyuan armies in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled as Commissioner of the Household Bureau and later served in succession as Military Commissioner of the Wuding and Kaiyuan armies.

sentences.zh: 統和六年致仕，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tonghe he retired and was given the additional title of Attending Minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tonghe (988) he retired and was given the additional title of Attending Minister.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十七。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太師。

translations.literal: He was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 子慎行，孫一德、二玄、三嘏、四端、五常、六符，皆具六符傳。

translations.literal: His son was Shenxing; his grandsons Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu—all have biographies under Liufu.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Shenxing; his grandsons Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu are all treated in the biography of Liufu.

sentences.zh: 劉六符，父慎行，由膳部員外郎累遷至北府宰相、監修國史。

translations.literal: Liu Liufu: his father Shenxing rose from an outside section official of the Board of Supplies to Northern Chancellor and Supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Liufu: his father Shenxing rose from an outside-section official of the Board of Supplies to Northern Chancellor and Supervisor of the National History.

sentences.zh: 時上多即宴飲行誅賞，慎行諫曰：「以喜怒加威福，恐未當。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor often handed out rewards and punishments at banquets; Shenxing remonstrated: "To link authority and favor to anger and joy may not be fitting.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor often meted out rewards and punishments over drink; Shenxing remonstrated: "To tie authority and favor to anger and joy may not be fitting.

sentences.zh: 」帝悟，諭政府「自今宴飲有刑賞事，翌日稟行」。

translations.literal: " The emperor took heed and instructed the government that "from now on, whenever rewards or punishments occur at banquets, they shall be reported for execution the following day."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor took the point and instructed the government that "from now on, whenever rewards or punishments arise at banquets, they are to be reported and carried out the next day."

sentences.zh: 為都統，伐高麗，以失軍期下吏，議貴乃免，出為彰武軍節度使。

translations.literal: As commander-in-chief he attacked Goryeo; for missing the army schedule he was handed over to the judiciary, debated for commutation, released, and sent out as Military Commissioner of Zhangwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: As commander-in-chief he campaigned against Goryeo; for missing the army schedule he was handed to the judiciary, commuted after debate on his rank, released, and sent out as Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army.

sentences.zh: 賜保節功臣。

translations.literal: He was granted the title of Meritorious Subject Who Preserves Integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the title Meritorious Subject Who Preserves Integrity.

sentences.zh: 子六人：一德、二玄、三嘏、四端、五常、六符。

translations.literal: He had six sons: Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu.
translations.idiomatic: He had six sons: Yide, Erxuan, Sangu, Siduan, Wuchang, and Liufu.

sentences.zh: 德早世。

translations.literal: Yide died young.
translations.idiomatic: Yide died young.

sentences.zh: 玄終上京留守。

translations.literal: Erxuan ended as military governor of the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Erxuan ended his career as military governor of the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 常歷三司使、武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: Wuchang served in succession as Commissioner of the Three Departments and Military Commissioner of Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: Wuchang served in succession as Commissioner of the Three Departments and as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 嘏、端、符皆第進士。

translations.literal: Sangu, Siduan, and Liufu all passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Sangu, Siduan, and Liufu all passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 嘏、端俱尚王，為駙馬都尉。

translations.literal: Sangu and Siduan both married princesses and became Commissioners of the Consorts' Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Sangu and Siduan both married princesses and became Commissioners of the Consorts' Bureau.

sentences.zh: 三嘏獻聖宗《一矢斃雙鹿賦》，上嘉其贍麗。

translations.literal: Sangu presented to Emperor Shengzong his fu "One Arrow Slays Two Stags"; the emperor praised its rich ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Sangu presented to Emperor Shengzong his fu "One Arrow Slays Two Stags," and the emperor praised its rich ornament.

sentences.zh: 與公主不諧，奔宋；

translations.literal: He did not get along with the princess and fled to Song;
translations.idiomatic: He did not get along with the princess and fled to Song;

sentences.zh: 歸，殺之。

translations.literal: on his return he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: on his return he was put to death.

sentences.zh: 四端以衛尉少卿使宋賀生辰，方宴，大張女樂，竟席不顧，人憚其嚴。

translations.literal: Siduan, as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, went to Song to congratulate the emperor's birthday; at the banquet female musicians were displayed at full scale, yet he finished the feast without a glance—people feared his severity.
translations.idiomatic: Siduan, as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, went to Song to congratulate the emperor's birthday; at the banquet female musicians were displayed in full array, yet he sat through the feast without a glance—men feared his severity.

sentences.zh: 還，拜樞密直學士。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六符有誌操，能文。

translations.literal: Liufu had moral purpose and could write.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu had firm moral purpose and was skilled in letters.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，遷政事舍人，擢翰林學士。

translations.literal: Early in Chongxi he was transferred to Administrative Scholar and promoted to Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi era he was made Administrative Scholar and promoted to Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 十一年，與宣徽使蕭特末使宋索十縣地；

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, together with Commissioner Xiao Temo he went as envoy to Song to demand the ten prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, together with Commissioner Xiao Temo he went as envoy to Song to demand the ten prefectures;

sentences.zh: 還，為漢人行宮副部署。

translations.literal: on his return he became Deputy Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Camp.
translations.idiomatic: on his return he became Deputy Commander of the Han Chinese Imperial Camp.

sentences.zh: 會宋遣使增歲幣以易十縣，復與耶律仁先使宋，定「進貢」名，宋難之。

translations.literal: When the Song sent envoys to increase the annual tribute to buy back the ten prefectures, he again went to Song with Yelu Renxian to fix the term "tribute contribution"; Song found this difficult.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song sent envoys offering increased annual tribute in exchange for the ten prefectures, he again went to Song with Yelu Renxian to fix the term "tribute contribution," which the Song resisted.

sentences.zh: 六符曰：「本朝兵強將勇，海內共知，人人願從事於宋。

translations.literal: Liufu said: "Our dynasty's soldiers are strong and generals brave—everyone within the seas knows it; every man would gladly campaign against Song.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu said: "Our dynasty's soldiers are strong and its generals brave—everyone within the seas knows it, and every man would gladly take the field against Song.

sentences.zh: 若恣其俘獲以飽所欲，與『進貢』字孰多？

translations.literal: If you let them seize captives at will to satisfy their desires, which is greater—the word 'tribute contribution' or that?
translations.idiomatic: If you let them seize captives at will to satisfy their desires, which weighs more—the word 'tribute contribution' or that?

sentences.zh: 況大兵駐燕，萬一南進，何以禦之！

translations.literal: Moreover, with a great army stationed at Yan, if it should march south by any chance, how would you resist it!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, with a great army stationed at Yan, if it should march south, how would you resist it!

sentences.zh: 顧小節，忘大患，悔將何及！

translations.literal: To cling to a small point and forget a great peril—when regret comes what will be left!
translations.idiomatic: To cling to a small point and forget a great peril—when regret comes, what will be left!

sentences.zh: 」宋乃從之，歲幣稱「貢」。

translations.literal: " Song then yielded; the annual tribute was called "tribute."
translations.idiomatic: " The Song then yielded, and the annual payments were styled "tribute."

sentences.zh: 六符還，加同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Liufu returned and was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Tongzhong Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu returned and was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Tongzhong Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 及宋幣至，命六符為三司使以受之。

translations.literal: When the Song tribute arrived, Liufu was ordered to serve as Commissioner of the Three Departments to receive it.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song tribute arrived, Liufu was ordered to serve as Commissioner of the Three Departments to receive it.

sentences.zh: 六符與參知政事杜防有隙，防以六符嘗受宋賂，白其事，出為長寧軍節度使，俄召為三司使。

translations.literal: Liufu and Participation Councilor Du Fang were at odds; Fang reported that Liufu had accepted bribes from Song, and he was sent out as Military Commissioner of Changning Army, but soon recalled as Commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Liufu and Participation Councilor Du Fang were at odds; Fang reported that Liufu had accepted bribes from Song, and Liufu was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Changning Army, but was soon recalled as Commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 道宗即位，將行大冊禮，北院樞密使蕭革曰：「行大禮備儀物，必擇廣地，莫若黃川。

translations.literal: When Emperor Daozong succeeded, as the great enfeoffment rite was about to be performed, Northern Commissioner Xiao Ge said: "To conduct a great ceremony and prepare ritual objects one must choose broad ground—none better than Huangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daozong succeeded, as the great enfeoffment rite was about to be performed, Northern Commissioner Xiao Ge said: "To conduct a great ceremony and prepare ritual objects one must choose broad ground—none is better than Huangchuan.

sentences.zh: 」六符曰：「不然。

translations.literal: " Liufu said: "Not so.
translations.idiomatic: " Liufu said: "Not so.

sentences.zh: 禮儀國之大體，帝王之樂不奏於野。

translations.literal: Ritual is the great body of the state; the emperor's music is not performed in the wild.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual is the great body of the state; the emperor's music is not performed in the open country.

sentences.zh: 今中京四方之極，朝覲各得其所，宜中京行之。

translations.literal: Now the Central Capital is the center of the four directions, and audiences each find their proper place—the rite ought to be performed at the Central Capital."
translations.idiomatic: The Central Capital is now the hub of the four directions, where audiences each find their proper place—the rite ought to be performed there."

sentences.zh: 」上從其議。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed this advice.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 尋以疾卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died of illness.

sentences.zh: 耶律履，字海鄰，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Lü, style name Hailin, was a descendant of Pugu Jr., Commissioner of the Six Institutes.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Lü, whose style name was Hailin, was a descendant of Pugu Jr., Commissioner of the Six Institutes.

sentences.zh: 風神爽秀，工於畫。

translations.literal: His bearing was bright and elegant; he was skilled at painting.
translations.idiomatic: His bearing was bright and elegant, and he was accomplished in painting.

sentences.zh: 重熙間，累遷同知點檢司事。

translations.literal: During Chongxi he rose in succession to Associate Director of the Inspection Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era he rose in succession to Associate Director of the Inspection Bureau.

sentences.zh: 駙馬都尉蕭胡睹為夏人所執，奉詔索之，三返以歸，轉永興宮使、右祗候郎君班詳穩。

translations.literal: When Cavalry Commander Xiao Hudu was seized by the Xia, he was ordered to demand his release; he returned after three missions and was transferred to Commissioner of the Ever-Flourishing Palace and detailed commander of the Right Imperial Guard Groom Corps.
translations.idiomatic: When Cavalry Commander Xiao Hudu was seized by the Xia, Lü was ordered to demand his release; after three missions he brought him back and was transferred to Commissioner of the Ever-Flourishing Palace and detailed commander of the Right Imperial Guard Groom Corps.

sentences.zh: 履將娶秦晉長公主孫，其母與公主婢有隙，謂履曰：「能去婢，乃許爾婚。

translations.literal: Lü was to marry the granddaughter of the Qin-Jin Grand Princess; his mother had a feud with the princess's maid and told Lü: "If you can get rid of the maid, then I will consent to your marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Lü was to marry the granddaughter of the Qin-Jin Grand Princess; his mother had a feud with the princess's maid and told Lü: "If you can get rid of the maid, then I will consent to your marriage.

sentences.zh: 」履以計殺之，婚成。

translations.literal: " Lü contrived to kill her, and the marriage was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: " Lü contrived to kill her, and the marriage was concluded.

sentences.zh: 事覺，有司以大辟論。

translations.literal: When the affair came to light, the judicial officials argued for the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair came to light, the judicial officials argued for the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 履善畫，寫聖宗真以獻，得減坐，長流邊戍。

translations.literal: Lü was skilled at painting; he painted a true likeness of Emperor Shengzong and presented it, his sentence was reduced, and he was banished long-term to frontier garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Lü was skilled at painting; he painted a true likeness of Emperor Shengzong and presented it, his sentence was reduced, and he was banished for long service on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 復以寫真，召拜同知南院宣徽事。

translations.literal: Again by painting portraits he was summoned and appointed Associate Director of the Southern Chancellery Commissioner's Office.
translations.idiomatic: Again by painting portraits he was summoned and appointed Associate Director of the Southern Chancellery Commissioner's Office.

sentences.zh: 使宋賀正，寫宋主容以歸。

translations.literal: As envoy to Song to congratulate the New Year he painted the Song ruler's likeness and brought it back.
translations.idiomatic: As envoy to Song to congratulate the New Year, he painted the Song ruler's likeness and brought it back.

sentences.zh: 清寧間，復使宋。

translations.literal: During Qingning he went again as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingning era he went again as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 宋主賜宴，瓶花隔面，未得其真。

translations.literal: The Song ruler gave a banquet; vase flowers blocked his face and he could not capture the true likeness.
translations.idiomatic: The Song ruler gave a banquet, but vase flowers blocked his face and Lü could not capture a true likeness.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，僅一視，及境，以像示餞者，駭其神妙。

translations.literal: At his farewell audience he merely glanced once; when he reached the border he showed the portrait to those seeing him off, who marveled at its miraculous skill.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience he merely glanced once; when he reached the border he showed the portrait to those seeing him off, who marveled at its miraculous skill.

sentences.zh: 聞重元亂，不即勤王。

translations.literal: Hearing of the Chongyuan rebellion, he did not hurry to the emperor's aid.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard of the Chongyuan rebellion, he did not hurry to the emperor's aid.

sentences.zh: 賊平入賀，帝責讓之。

translations.literal: When the rebels were suppressed he entered to offer congratulations; the emperor reproached him.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were suppressed he entered to offer congratulations, and the emperor reproached him.

sentences.zh: 宴酣，顧履曰：「重元事成，卿必得為上客！

translations.literal: As the banquet grew merry the emperor looked at Lü and said: "If Chongyuan's affair had succeeded, you would certainly have been an honored guest!
translations.idiomatic: As the banquet grew merry the emperor looked at Lü and said: "If Chongyuan's affair had succeeded, you would certainly have been an honored guest!

sentences.zh: 」履大慚。

translations.literal: " Lü was deeply ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: " Lü was deeply ashamed.

sentences.zh: 咸雍中，加太子太師，卒。

translations.literal: During Xianyong he was given the additional title Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianyong era he was given the additional title Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and died.

sentences.zh: 牛溫舒，范陽人。

translations.literal: Niu Wenshu, a native of Fanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Niu Wenshu was a native of Fanyang.

sentences.zh: 剛正尚節義，有遠器。

translations.literal: Upright and principled, he cherished integrity and had far-reaching capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Upright and principled, he prized integrity and possessed far-reaching capacity.

sentences.zh: 咸雍中，擢進士第，滯小官。

translations.literal: During Xianyong he passed the jinshi and was stuck in minor posts.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianyong era he passed the jinshi examination but remained long in minor posts.

sentences.zh: 大安初，累遷戶部使，轉給事中、知三司使事。

translations.literal: Early in Da'an he rose in succession to Commissioner of the Household Bureau, then Censor and Acting Commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Da'an era he rose in succession to Commissioner of the Household Bureau, then Censor and Acting Commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 國民兼足，上以為能，加戶部侍郎，改三司使。

translations.literal: The people were provided for in full; the emperor considered him capable, promoted him to Vice Minister of the Household Bureau, and made him Commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: The people were fully provided for; the emperor considered him capable, promoted him to Vice Minister of the Household Bureau, and made him Commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 壽隆中，拜參知政事，兼同知樞密院事，攝中京留守。

translations.literal: During Shoulong he was appointed Participation Councilor, concurrently Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and acting military governor of the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shoulong era he was made Participation Councilor, concurrently Associate Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and acting military governor of the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 部民詣闕請真拜，從之。

translations.literal: The people of his district went to court to request formal appointment, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The people of his district went to court to request that his acting appointment be made formal, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 召為三司使。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as Commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 乾統初，復參知政事，知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: Early in Qiantong he again became Participation Councilor and took charge of Southern Chancellery military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qiantong era he again became Participation Councilor and took charge of Southern Chancellery military affairs.

sentences.zh: 五年，夏為宋所攻，來請和解。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, when Xia was attacked by Song, they came to request reconciliation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, when Xia was attacked by Song, the Xia came to request a mediated peace.

sentences.zh: 溫舒與蕭得裏底使宋。

translations.literal: Wenshu and Xiao Delidi went as envoys to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Wenshu and Xiao Delidi were sent as envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 方大燕，優人為道士裝，索土泥藥爐。

translations.literal: At a great banquet in Yan, a performer dressed as a Daoist and asked for earth to mix a medicine furnace.
translations.idiomatic: At a great banquet in Yan, a performer dressed as a Daoist and asked for earth to mix a medicine furnace.

sentences.zh: 優曰：「土少不能和。

translations.literal: The performer said: "Too little earth cannot be mixed.
translations.idiomatic: The performer said: "Too little earth cannot be mixed."

sentences.zh: 」溫舒遽起，以手藉土懷之。

translations.literal: " Wenshu rose at once, took earth in his hands, and tucked it in his bosom.
translations.idiomatic: " Wenshu rose at once, took earth in his hands, and tucked it in his bosom.

sentences.zh: 宋主問其故，溫舒對曰：「臣奉天子威命來和，若不從，則當卷土收去。

translations.literal: The Song ruler asked the reason; Wenshu replied: "Your servant comes under the Son of Heaven's august mandate to make peace; if you do not agree, then I must roll up the earth and take it away.
translations.idiomatic: The Song ruler asked why; Wenshu replied: "I come under the Son of Heaven's mandate to make peace; if you do not agree, I shall roll up the earth and take it away."

sentences.zh: 」宋人大驚，遂許夏和。

translations.literal: " The Song were greatly alarmed and thereupon agreed to peace with Xia.
translations.idiomatic: " The Song were greatly alarmed and thereupon agreed to peace with Xia.

sentences.zh: 還，加中書令，卒。

translations.literal: On his return he was promoted to Director of the Secretariat and died.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was promoted to Director of the Secretariat and soon died.

sentences.zh: 杜防，涿州歸義縣人。

translations.literal: Du Fang, a native of Guiyi County in Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Du Fang was a native of Guiyi County in Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 開泰五年，擢進士甲科，累遷起居郎、知制誥，人以為有宰相器。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kaitai he passed the jinshi in the top class, rose in succession to Attendant of the Secretariat and Director of Edicts, and people considered him to have the makings of a chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Kaitai (1016) he passed the jinshi in the top class, rose in succession to Attendant of the Secretariat and Director of Edicts, and men considered him to have the makings of a chancellor.

sentences.zh: 太平中，遷政事舍人，拜樞密副使。

translations.literal: During Taiping he was transferred to Administrative Scholar and appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping era he was made Administrative Scholar and appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 重熙九年，夏人侵宋。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chongxi, the Xia invaded Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Chongxi (1040), the Xia invaded Song territory.

sentences.zh: 宋遣郭稹來告，請與夏和，上命防使夏解之。

translations.literal: Song sent Guo Zhen to report and request peace with Xia; the emperor ordered Fang to go to Xia to settle it.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent Guo Zhen to report the situation and request peace with Xia; the emperor ordered Fang to go to Xia and mediate.

sentences.zh: 如約罷兵，各歸侵地，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: As agreed the armies were withdrawn and each side returned invaded territory; he was appointed Participation Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: As agreed the armies stood down and each side returned seized territory; Fang was appointed Participation Councilor.

sentences.zh: 韓紹芳、劉六符忌之，防待以誠。

translations.literal: Han Shaofang and Liu Liufu were jealous of him, but Fang treated them with sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shaofang and Liu Liufu were jealous of him, yet Fang treated them with sincerity.

sentences.zh: 十二年，紹芳等罷，愈見信任。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, when Shaofang and others were dismissed, he was trusted all the more.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, when Shaofang and the others were dismissed, he won still greater trust.

sentences.zh: 十三年，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was appointed Southern Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was appointed Southern Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十五年，防生子，帝幸其第，賜名王門奴。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, when Fang had a son, the emperor visited his residence and bestowed the name Wang Mennu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, when Fang had a son, the emperor visited his residence and bestowed the name Wang Mennu.

sentences.zh: 以進奏有誤，出為武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: For an error in a memorial report he was sent out as Military Commissioner of Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: For an error in a memorial report he was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 十七年，復召為南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was again summoned as Southern Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was again summoned as Southern Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 二十一年秋，祭仁德皇后，詔儒臣賦詩，防為冠，賜金帶。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-first year, at the sacrifice to Empress Rend, the emperor ordered Confucian officials to compose poems; Fang took first place and was granted a gold belt.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-first year, at the sacrifice to Empress Rend, the emperor ordered Confucian officials to compose poems; Fang's poem ranked first and he was granted a gold belt.

sentences.zh: 道宗諒陰，為大行皇帝山陵使。

translations.literal: During Emperor Daozong's mourning seclusion, he served as commissioner for the late emperor's mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Daozong's mourning seclusion, he served as commissioner for the late emperor's mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 清寧二年，上諭防曰：「朕以卿年老嗜酒，不欲煩以劇務。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingning the emperor instructed Fang: "Because you are old and fond of wine, I do not wish to burden you with heavy duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qingning the emperor told Fang: "Because you are old and fond of wine, I do not wish to burden you with heavy duties."

sentences.zh: 朝廷之事，總綱而已。

translations.literal: Matters of court need only your general oversight.
translations.idiomatic: Court affairs need only your general oversight."

sentences.zh: 」頃之，拜右丞相，加尚父，卒。

translations.literal: " Shortly afterward he was appointed Right Chancellor, given the additional title Imperial Father, and died.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long he was appointed Right Chancellor, given the additional title Imperial Father, and died.

sentences.zh: 上嘆悼不已，赗贈加等，官給葬具，贈中書令，謚曰元肅。

translations.literal: The emperor lamented without end, increased funeral gifts, supplied burial goods by office, posthumously honored him as Director of the Secretariat, and gave the posthumous title Yuansu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor lamented without end, increased funeral gifts, supplied burial goods from the court, posthumously honored him as Director of the Secretariat, and gave the posthumous title Yuansu.

sentences.zh: 子公謂，終南府宰相。

translations.literal: His son Gongwei ended as Southern Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: His son Gongwei ended his career as Southern Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 蕭和尚，字洪寧，國舅大父房之後。

translations.literal: Xiao Heshang, style name Hongning, was a descendant of the Grand Imperial Uncle's father's line.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Heshang, whose style name was Hongning, was a descendant of the Grand Imperial Uncle's father's line.

sentences.zh: 忠直，多智略。

translations.literal: Loyal and upright, he possessed much strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal and upright, he possessed considerable strategic talent.

sentences.zh: 開泰初，補禦盞郎君，尋為內史、太醫等局都林牙。

translations.literal: Early in Kaitai he was appointed Cupbearer Attendant, and soon became Chief Secretary of the Inner History, Imperial Physicians, and related bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kaitai era he entered service as Cupbearer Attendant and soon became Chief Secretary of the Inner History, Imperial Physicians, and related bureaus.

sentences.zh: 使宋賀正，將宴，典儀者告，班節度使下。

translations.literal: As envoy to Song to congratulate the New Year, when a banquet was about to be held the master of ceremonies announced that his rank was below that of a military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: As envoy to Song to congratulate the New Year, when a banquet was about to be held the master of ceremonies announced that his seat was ranked below that of a military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 和尚曰：「班次如此，是不以大國之使相禮。

translations.literal: Heshang said: "If the seating is thus, it is not to treat an envoy of a great state with proper ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Heshang said: "If the seating is arranged thus, it is not to treat an envoy of a great state with proper ceremony."

sentences.zh: 且以錦服為貺，如待蕃部。

translations.literal: Moreover, to give brocade robes as gifts is like treating a frontier tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, to give brocade robes as gifts is like treating a frontier tribe."

sentences.zh: 若果如是，吾不預宴。

translations.literal: If it is truly thus, I will not attend the banquet.
translations.idiomatic: If that is truly the case, I will not attend the banquet."

sentences.zh: 」宋臣不能對，賜以紫服，位視執政，使禮始定。

translations.literal: " Song officials could not reply; they granted him purple robes, a rank equal to chief ministers, and envoy protocol was settled.
translations.idiomatic: " The Song officials could not answer; they granted him purple robes, a rank equal to chief ministers, and envoy protocol was at last fixed.

sentences.zh: 八年秋，為唐古部節度使，卒。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year he became Military Commissioner of the Tangut Tribes and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the eighth year he became Military Commissioner of the Tangut Tribes and died.

sentences.zh: 弟特末。

translations.literal: His younger brother was Temo.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Temo.

sentences.zh: 特末，字何寧。

translations.literal: Temo, style name Hening.
translations.idiomatic: Temo, whose style name was Hening.

sentences.zh: 為人機辨任氣。

translations.literal: In person he was quick-witted and headstrong.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was quick-witted and headstrong.

sentences.zh: 太平中，累遷安東軍節度使，有能稱。

translations.literal: During Taiping he rose in succession to Military Commissioner of Andong Army and won a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping era he rose in succession to Military Commissioner of the Andong Army and won a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 十一年，召為左祗候郎君班詳穩。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was summoned as detailed commander of the Left Imperial Guard Groom Corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was summoned as detailed commander of the Left Imperial Guard Groom Corps.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷左夷離畢。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Left Yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to Left Yilibi.

sentences.zh: 重熙十年，累遷北院宣徽使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chongxi he rose in succession to Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Chongxi (1041) he rose in succession to Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明年，與劉六符使宋，索十縣故地，宋請增銀、絹十萬兩、匹以易之。

translations.literal: The following year, together with Liu Liufu he went as envoy to Song to demand the ten former prefectures; Song requested to increase silver and silk by one hundred thousand taels and bolts in exchange.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, together with Liu Liufu he went as envoy to Song to demand the ten former prefectures; Song offered to increase silver and silk payments by one hundred thousand taels and bolts in exchange.

sentences.zh: 歸，稱旨，加同政事門下平章事。

translations.literal: On his return he pleased the emperor and was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Tongzheng Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he pleased the emperor and was made Associate Grand Councilor of the Tongzheng Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔城西南渾底甸。

translations.literal: He was ordered to fortify the Hun Di district in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to fortify the Hun Di district in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 還，復為北院宣徽使，卒。

translations.literal: On his return he again became Northern Chancellery Commissioner and died.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he again became Northern Chancellery Commissioner and died.

sentences.zh: 耶律合裏只，字特滿，六院夷離堇蒲古只之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Helizhi, style name Teman, was a descendant of Pugu Jr., Commissioner of the Six Institutes.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Helizhi, whose style name was Teman, was a descendant of Pugu Jr., Commissioner of the Six Institutes.

sentences.zh: 重熙中，累遷西南面招討都監。

translations.literal: During Chongxi he rose in succession to Commander of Southwestern Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi era he rose in succession to Commander of Southwestern Pacification.

sentences.zh: 充宋國生辰使，館於白溝驛。

translations.literal: Serving as envoy to Song for the emperor's birthday, he lodged at Baigou Post.
translations.idiomatic: Serving as envoy to Song for the emperor's birthday, he lodged at Baigou Post.

sentences.zh: 宋宴勞，優者嘲蕭惠河西之敗。

translations.literal: At a Song banquet in his honor, a performer mocked Xiao Hui's defeat west of the river.
translations.idiomatic: At a Song banquet in his honor, a performer mocked Xiao Hui's defeat west of the river.

sentences.zh: 合裏只曰：「勝負兵家常事。

translations.literal: Helizhi said: "Victory and defeat are common in warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Helizhi said: "Victory and defeat are common in warfare."

sentences.zh: 我嗣聖皇帝俘石重貴，至今興中有石家寨。

translations.literal: Our dynastic founder Emperor captured Shi Chonggui, and to this day in Xing there is the Shi Family Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynastic founder captured Shi Chonggui, and to this day in Xing there is the Shi Family Stockade."

sentences.zh: 惠之一敗，何足較哉！

translations.literal: One defeat by Hui—what is there to compare!
translations.idiomatic: What is one defeat by Hui beside that!"

sentences.zh: 」宋人慚服。

translations.literal: " The Song were ashamed and impressed.
translations.idiomatic: " The Song were ashamed and impressed.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之曰：「優令失辭，何可傷兩國交好！

translations.literal: The emperor heard of it and said: "The performer's words were improper—how could they harm good relations between the two states!
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it he said: "The performer's words were improper—how could they harm good relations between the two states!"

sentences.zh: 」鞭二百，免官。

translations.literal: " He was given two hundred lashes and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: " He was given two hundred lashes and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，起為懷化軍節度使。

translations.literal: Early in Qingning he was recalled as Military Commissioner of Huaihua Army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qingning era he was recalled as Military Commissioner of the Huaihua Army.

sentences.zh: 七年，入為北院大王，封豳國公。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he entered court as Northern Chancellery King and was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he entered court as Northern Chancellery King and was enfeoffed as Duke of Bin.

sentences.zh: 歷遼興軍節度使、東北路詳穩，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: He served in succession as Military Commissioner of Liaoxing Army and detailed commander of the Northeast Route, and was given the additional title Attending Minister.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as Military Commissioner of the Liaoxing Army and detailed commander of the Northeast Route, and was given the additional title Attending Minister.

sentences.zh: 致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office and died.

sentences.zh: 合裏只明達勤恪，懷柔有道。

translations.literal: Helizhi was clear-sighted, diligent, and skilled in winning people by gentleness.
translations.idiomatic: Helizhi was clear-sighted and diligent, and skilled in winning people through gentle rule.

sentences.zh: 置諸賓館及西邊營田，皆自合裏只發之。

translations.literal: The establishment of guesthouses and western frontier military farms all originated with Helizhi.
translations.idiomatic: The establishment of guesthouses and western frontier military farms all originated with Helizhi.

sentences.zh: 耶律頗的，字撒版，季父房奴瓜之孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Pode, style name Saban, was a grandson of Nugua of the Younger Father's line.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Pode, whose style name was Saban, was a grandson of Nugua of the Younger Father's line.

sentences.zh: 孤介寡合。

translations.literal: Aloof and solitary, he kept little company.
translations.idiomatic: Aloof and solitary, he kept little company.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，補牌印郎君。

translations.literal: Early in Chongxi he was appointed Seal and Patent Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi era he was appointed Seal and Patent Attendant.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，稍遷知易州。

translations.literal: Early in Qingning he was gradually transferred to govern Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qingning era he was gradually transferred to govern Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 去官，部民請留，許之。

translations.literal: When he left office the people of his district asked that he remain, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: When he left office the people of his district asked that he remain, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 咸雍八年，改彰國軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianyong he was transferred as Military Commissioner of Zhangguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xianyong he was transferred as Military Commissioner of the Zhangguo Army.

sentences.zh: 上獵大牢古山，頗的謁於行宮。

translations.literal: When the emperor hunted at Mount Dalaogu, Pode paid his respects at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor hunted at Mount Dalaogu, Pode paid his respects at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 帝問邊事，對曰：「自應州南境至天池，皆我耕牧之地。

translations.literal: The emperor asked about frontier affairs; he replied: "From the southern border of Ying Prefecture to Tianchi, all is our land for farming and grazing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked about frontier affairs; he replied: "From the southern border of Ying Prefecture to Tianchi, all is our land for farming and grazing."

sentences.zh: 清寧間，邊將不謹，為宋所侵，烽堠內移，似非所宜。

translations.literal: During Qingning frontier generals were not careful and were invaded by Song; beacon towers were moved inward, which seems inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingning era frontier generals were careless and Song encroached; beacon towers were moved inward, which seems ill-advised."

sentences.zh: 」道宗然之。

translations.literal: " Emperor Daozong approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Daozong agreed.

sentences.zh: 拜北面林牙。

translations.literal: He was appointed Northern Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Northern Secretary.

sentences.zh: 後遣人使宋，得其侵地，命頗的往定疆界。

translations.literal: Later envoys were sent to Song and recovered invaded territory; Pode was ordered to go and fix the boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Later envoys were sent to Song and recovered the seized territory; Pode was ordered to go and fix the boundaries.

sentences.zh: 還，拜南院宣徽使。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Southern Chancellery Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed Southern Chancellery Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 大康四年，遷忠順軍節度使，尋為南院大王，改同知南京留守事，召拜南府宰相，賜貞良功臣，封吳國公，為北院樞密使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dakang he was transferred as Military Commissioner of Zhongshun Army; soon he became Southern Chancellery King, then Associate Military Governor of the Southern Capital, summoned as Southern Chancellor, granted the title Meritorious Subject of Upright Integrity, enfeoffed as Duke of Wu, and made Northern Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Dakang he was transferred as Military Commissioner of the Zhongshun Army; soon he became Southern Chancellery King, then Associate Military Governor of the Southern Capital, summoned as Southern Chancellor, granted the title Meritorious Subject of Upright Integrity, enfeoffed as Duke of Wu, and made Northern Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 廉謹奉公，知無不為。

translations.literal: Frugal, careful, and dutiful to the public, he did whatever he knew should be done.
translations.idiomatic: Frugal, careful, and dutiful to the public, he did whatever he knew should be done.

sentences.zh: 大安中致仕，卒。

translations.literal: During Da'an he retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Da'an era he retired and died.

sentences.zh: 子霞抹，北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: His son Xiamo became Vice Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiamo became Vice Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 論曰：耶律合住安邊講好，養兵息民，其慮深遠矣。

translations.literal: Commentary: Yelu Hezhu secured the frontier and sought peace, rested the armies and eased the people—his foresight was far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Yelu Hezhu secured the frontier and sought peace, rested the armies and eased the people—his foresight was far-reaching.

sentences.zh: 六符啟釁邀功，豈國家之利哉？

translations.literal: Liufu stirred up trouble to win credit—was that to the state's benefit?
translations.idiomatic: Liufu stirred up trouble to win credit—was that to the state's benefit?

sentences.zh: 牛、杜、頗的、合裏只輩銜命出使，幸不辱命。

translations.literal: Niu, Du, Pode, Helizhi, and their like went abroad on imperial commission and, happily, did not disgrace their charge.
translations.idiomatic: Niu, Du, Pode, Helizhi, and men of their kind went abroad on imperial commission and, happily, did not disgrace their charge.

sentences.zh: 裏殺人婢以求婚，身負罪釁，畫其主容，以冀免死，亦可醜也。

translations.literal: Lü killed a maid to obtain a marriage, bore a criminal stain on his person, and painted his sovereign's likeness hoping to escape death—this too is shameful.
translations.idiomatic: Lü killed a maid to obtain a marriage, bore a criminal stain, and painted his sovereign's likeness hoping to escape death—that too is shameful.
